fields.description:
APPROVED (operator sign-off recorded 2026-07-24). Add a new Pass-4 coach move for T15 findings. Existing moves 1 (spike), 4 (riskiest-assumption test), and 7 (thin vertical slice) are adjacent but none captures the T15 remedy. The move is deliberately distinct from move 1: spike is a PLANNING-TIME experiment before plan approval that proves a mechanism or syntax and yields a decision; out-of-loop proof is an EXECUTION-TIME step the plan itself includes to prove the actual implementation works before it enters the slow delivery loop.

Move id 15 was available when this story was approved, but it has since landed as `sample, not the population` under prerequisite `amoral-natatorial-dog`. Preserve that shipped move unchanged and allocate the next free built-in id, 16, to this approved move.

## Work
- Add key `16` to `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/coach_moves.py` `MOVE_REGISTRY` with name `out-of-loop proof`, the approved template below verbatim, and `applies_when: ["T15"]`:

  `Build an out-of-loop proof of {subject} into the plan — an execution step that confirms the implementation works via the fastest local run or manual probe against the real target, before it is committed to the slow delivery loop.`
- Preserve move 15 and every other existing registry entry unchanged.
- Add the matching move-16 row to the mirrored coaching table in `docs/plan-review-gate.md`.
- Add `out-of-loop proof` to the remaining registered moves in `src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md`, describing it as an execution step before the slow delivery loop rather than a planning-time spike.
- Extend `tests/unit/test_plan_review.py` with exact registry, scoped-applicability, deterministic-rendering, and negative-trigger contracts for move 16.
- Extend `tests/unit/test_guides.py` with the observable author-guide one-line contract.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `MOVE_REGISTRY["16"]` has name `out-of-loop proof`, the approved template verbatim, and exactly one `{subject}` placeholder.
- [ ] `MOVE_REGISTRY["16"]` declares exactly `["T15"]` in `applies_when`.
- [ ] `validate_move_registry` accepts the complete built-in registry with move 16.
- [ ] A surviving T15 finding can select move 16 and renders the approved template deterministically with the bounded subject substituted.
- [ ] Move 16 is not offered when T15 is absent from the active finding criteria.
- [ ] Move 15 remains `sample, not the population` with its existing template and trigger set unchanged.
- [ ] The move table in `docs/plan-review-gate.md` mirrors move 16 exactly.
- [ ] The author guide names `out-of-loop proof` and distinguishes its execution-time step from the planning-time `spike` move.
- [ ] The focused plan-review and review-kernel suites pass with the new scoped move.

## Testing
- Run `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_plan_review.py tests/unit/test_review_kernel.py tests/unit/test_guides.py -q`.
- Run `.venv/bin/python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry validate-routing`.
- Run `make lint` and `make typecheck`.
- Inspect the registry diff to confirm it adds move 16 without modifying move 15 or another existing move.
fields.title: Add coach move 16 'out-of-loop proof' (applies_when T15) — APPROVED
